```blitzbasic
GadgetGroup:Int32 gadget:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of the gadget. |

**Returns:** The handle of the group (window, panel, tabber or canvas) that holds the gadget.
